about_the_game:
Step into the mysterious realm of Horrows End, a quaint town cloaked in mystery and waiting for brave souls to uncover its hidden truths. In this atmospheric, story-driven horror game, shadows conceal untold horrors, while the light reveals astonishing mysteries.

From the eerie silence of abandoned cabins to the chilling whispers carried by the wind, every corner of Horrows End holds the potential for spine-tingling discoveries. As you navigate this unsettling environment, you'll encounter a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories to tell.

The game weaves together multiple interwoven tales, creating a rich and immersive narrative that will captivate you from the first moment. Are you ready to delve into the unknown, confront your deepest fears, and unravel the mysteries that lie in wait?

Embark on your journey through Horrows End for an unforgettable adventure that will keep your heart pounding and leave you yearning for more.
